description: Implementation of a mock certificate verifier class for testing, including request handling, rule management, and observer pattern.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier::Rule
classes.description: Defines a rule for certificate verification, associating a certificate, hostname pattern, result, and return value.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier::MockRequest
classes.description: Represents a mock request for certificate verification, handling asynchronous result returning.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier
classes.description: A mock implementation of a certificate verifier for testing purposes, supporting rule management and observer notifications.

classes.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
classes.description: Counts the number of times the certificate verifier change notification is triggered.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, either synchronously or asynchronously based on configuration.

methods.name: AddResultForCert
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate.

methods.name: AddResultForCertAndHost
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate and hostname pattern.

methods.name: SimulateOnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Simulates a change notification for the certificate verifier.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles the notification that the certificate verifier has changed, incrementing the change count.
